verdict.rationale: Cake's own docs cover every named element of the cap table. Share classes are documented, including conversions (docs-18, 30). Certificates are issued digitally, come in holdings and transactional types, and legacy certificates can be linked (docs-22, 33, 34). SAFEs and convertibles are raised and contracted in the product (docs-6, 7), and option grants run on a vesting engine with ISO/NSO support (docs-4, 5). All of this sits in a live cap table view (docs-36), and investors see their holdings through a separate My Cake portal (docs-46, 14). Corporate actions such as splits and buy-backs are also handled (docs-31, 32). Missing for 10: any evidence of auditor-facing features such as audit trails or auditor access, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
